198 likes, 18 comments - budgetbytes on October 27, 2026: "Worms in Dirt is a Halloween classic, and ours starts with rich homemade chocolate pudding instead of the boxed stuff! 🍫 It works as a party spread, a fun Halloween lunch box treat, or an activity the kids can help assemble. You can even make the pudding up to 2 days ahead and build the cups right before serving so the crumbs stay crunchy! 🪱🐛Happy Halloween!! 

Comment RECIPE and we’ll DM it to you (make sure you’re following us to get it), or grab it at the link in our profile. @budgetbytes

https://www.budgetbytes.com/worms-in-dirt/".
